text:
jessica: Quick question — should the pin/lease schema carry an explicit owner field (team_id/principal) or leave ownership implicit via previous pin metadata? worried about handoff + audits.

arjun: Explicit owner. Makes TTL renewal, audits, and billing attribution sane.

marco: Explicit owner helps but increases complexity for fallback policies (owner service down). we might need owner_type enum: user | team | system.

jessica: +1 on enum. Migration concern: existing pins have no owner. proposal: treat null owner as system-owned for reads, require owner for new writes. ok?

arjun: migration plan sounds OK. also include optional owner_contact (pager/email) so oncall knows who to call.

sre-bot: deploy: rollout-pin-schema-v2 job started on infra-dev :gear:

marco: conflict scenario — two services pin same model with different owners. option A: last-writer-wins; option B: optimistic claim with expected_version. prefer B.

jessica: LWW can cause accidental evictions. Claim API with expected_version + 409 on mismatch seems safer and still simple.

arjun: +1. propose fields: lease_version (int), grace_hold (bool), owner_priority (int) optional. claim must pass expected_lease_version. server returns current owner + version on 409.

olivia: product: console should surface owner, contact, lease_version, and a "request release" flow that sends email/Slack to owner. also audit trail for owner changes.

jessica: audit requirement noted — owner changes must emit structured audit events. minimal audit schema: event_type, actor, prev_owner, new_owner, reason, ts.

marco: security note: for Private deployments validate owner_id against tenant_id and ACLs. KMS/HSM keys must be tenant-scoped.

jessica: sample schema sketch (for RFC follow-up):
```json
{
  "lease_id": "string",
  "model_id": "string",
  "owner_type": "enum(user|team|system)",
  "owner_id": "string (nullable)",
  "owner_contact": "string (nullable)",
  "lease_ttl_seconds": "int",
  "lease_version": "int",
  "grace_hold": "bool",
  "created_by": "string",
  "created_ts": "iso8601",
  "last_renewed_ts": "iso8601"
}
```

marco: migration steps idea: (1) read existing pins -> mark as system-owned with lease_version=1, (2) backfill created_ts where missing, (3) enforce owner required for new writes after a cutoff date, (4) provide admin endpoint to claim/reassign with audit.

arjun: API semantics: POST /leases -> 201 with lease, POST /leases/{id}/claim -> 200 if version matches, 409 returns {current_owner, lease_version, hint}. clients should retry with user confirmation.

jessica: edge-case: cross-tenant pin attempts should 403. make sure routing + smart-routing honors owner constraints when evicting caches.

olivia: product asks for a short migration notice to customers and a console banner during migration window.

jessica: action items: I'll draft RFC follow-up with schema + migration plan + API error shapes. tagging @arjun @marco @olivia for review. :thumbsup: 

arjun: thanks — lgtm to iterate.

marco: will add concurrency tests and a quick sim for conflict scenarios.

sre-bot: alert: schema-rollout-v2 queued for staging at 3421234600

jessica: perfect. I'll send the draft this afternoon and link the test matrix.
